sentences.text:
An Application For Anticipatory Bail ... vs Anup Dey @ Anup
Kumar Dey on 30 August, 2016

Author: Patherya
Bench: Patherya
30. 08 .2016 Rejected C.R.M. 5335 of 2016.

In the matter of : An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 20th June, 2016 in connection with Nandigram Police Station Case No 445 of 2015 dated 22. 10. 2015 under Sections 272/273 of the Indian Penal Code read with West Bengal Act 42 of 1973 Sections 3/328/304/120B of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 46AA of the Bengal Excise Act and Section 16(3) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, G.R. Case No. 1833 of 2015.
And

entities.text: Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, G.R. Case No. 1833 of 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
In the matter of : Anup Dey @ Anup Kumar Dey ..Petitioner.
Mr. Sandip Kundu .. for the Petitioner.
Mr. Rudradipta Nandy .. for the State.
Defence counsel submits that the petitioner is no longer desirous of proceeding with this application.
Accordingly, this application is rejected as not pressed.
Certified copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the parties on priority basis.

( Patherya, J.) ( Debi Prosad Dey, J. )
